name: Telegram Views & Reactions Bot
description: Telegram SMM bot — views & reactions booster with multi-account session management. Accounts auto-backup to MongoDB, so they survive Heroku dyno restarts.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID (my.telegram.org). Optional — hardcoded default is used when left blank.

API_HASH.description: Telegram API hash (my.telegram.org). Optional — hardcoded default is used when left blank.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Optional — hardcoded default is used when left blank.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string (mongodb+srv://...). Optional — hardcoded default is used when left blank.

OWNER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to use the bot. Optional — hardcoded default is used when left blank.
